en: Dependent on an internal state that is a root-cause, an external state that is not a root-cause arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on an external state that is a root-cause, an internal state that is not a root-cause arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are two; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are two.
Dependent on an internal state that is not a cause, there arises externally a state that is neither a cause nor associated with a cause, by way of root condition.
